_doc: Voice design for the inner voices (skills); one narrator speaks every skill line, as in Disco Elysium.
text: Listen. Under the rain there is another sound, older, slower. Stone settling. A wall remembering a winter when nobody came. You are tired, and the cold has found the gap in your collar. Good. Tired people notice things. Look again, and do not blink first.

candidates.deep: A deep, resonant, intimate male voice, ageless, speaking slowly and very close like a thought inside your own head, calm and faintly amused, warm bass with a soft breathy edge, a measured British accent. Close to the microphone, dry room.
candidates.velvet: A low, smoky male voice in his forties, conspiratorial and dry, half-whispered, unhurried, savouring words, a slight rasp, a neutral British accent, like a storyteller leaning in. Close to the microphone, dry room.
